scope: Independent read-only review of dated snapshot helper adaptation, not actual database/runtime/release approval
checked: Import path resolves the same held production connection/error guard and adds the existing exact-ledger verifier
Phase accepts only predeploy/postdeploy and outputs a new exclusive dated-folder receipt
Ledger read compares27 ordered version/name pairs against recorded canonical manifest instead of only counting
Connection guard pins project, production branch/name, one direct read-write endpoint/host, database/role/port and verify-full TLS; no pooler endpoint substitution
BEGIN READ ONLY and transaction_read_only=on check precede all ledger/aggregate reads; rollback/end retained
pg_stat_activity query selects only counts, excludes own PID; no query text, SQL bodies, customer IDs, cookies or credentials selected/persisted
Cards/images/projects/boards are aggregate counts only; failures serialize existing sanitized class/code/status fields, no raw error message/connection URI
New receipt is exclusive wx; existing receipt cannot be overwritten; no backup/migration/deployment calls added
limits: At actual root execution connection() obtains connection material privately in memory; this reviewer did not call/import it
Read-only transaction uses default isolation; separate aggregate queries are not one immutable data snapshot and cannot prove row/content equality
Exact ledger names/versions do not themselves prove stored SQL checksums or full current schema correctness
Metrics observe other sessions; concurrent normal application/cron activity can change counts
Root must require completed report/exit and unused phase receipt before executing; wx protects overwrite but is checked on final write after reads
Actual pre/post values and provider identity at execution remain unverified until root receipts exist
No formal backend score or final release/backup/Owner acceptance is implied
